treatment.schedule_summary: Vinblastine6 mg/m² IV in50 mL sodium chloride0.9% over 10 minutes plus methotrexate30 mg/m² IV bolus on Days 1,8,15 of each28-day cycle; Day 22 is rest. Total12 cycles unless progression or unacceptable toxicity. Vinblastine is FOR INTRAVENOUS USE ONLY; other routes can be fatal.

eligibility: Advanced aggressive fibromatosis. This is not a metastatic soft-tissue-sarcoma indication.
monitoring: Baseline FBC, renal/liver profile and chest X-ray. FBC and renal/liver profiles before each cycle; review counts and treatment suitability on scheduled treatment days under the treating plan.
Monitor mucositis, neuropathy, constipation/ileus, infection, new cough or breathlessness and third-space fluid collections.
Use the low-dose MTX product pathway: this30 mg/m² regimen does not justify importing high-dose MTX rescue/hydration schedules. Review interactions and renal function carefully.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Risk assigned from the most emetogenic active component and treatment phase.
supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for low emetogenic risk
additional_supportive_care: Methotrexate has low emetogenic potential; vinblastine minimal. No usual specific premedication or other supportive medication is listed by the regimen.
Retain IV-only vinblastine safeguards, oral-care advice, bowel/neuropathy monitoring and urgent infection/respiratory advice. No routine G-CSF or high-dose MTX rescue is inferred.
